title: Value Judgements and Evaluative Subjunctive
goal: Deliver C1 evaluative judgements across present and past frames using the subjunctive

items: I can use higher-register evaluative triggers like *resulta absurdo que* and *es lamentable que* with the subjunctive.
I can shift between present, present perfect and imperfect subjunctive according to the time frame.
I can choose the infinitive for general judgements when no specific subject is named.
